name_input: BASCO TOOL PRIVATE LIMITED; BASCO TOOL PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: No export (outbound) shipment record found. ImportKey page for BASCO TOOL PRIVATE LIMITED (https://importkey.com/countries/india/basco-tool-private-limited) reports 'Total Shipments 409 Records detected' but every visible row is an inbound import into India, e.g. exact line: '2026-01-02 | ZHUZHOU RARYU CARBIDE CO.LTD. | BASCO TOOL PRIVATE LIMITED | CARBIDE SAW TIPS4# RY-K01 FOR ALUMINUM(8.5*3.5*2.5) | SHANGHAI, CHINA -> DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | HS 82090010 | BOL 6678062'. Destination column is always India; no destination country outside India, no export B/L. Source counter: page claims 409 total shipments; rows actually seen = 5 (dates 2026-01-02, 2025-12-11, 2025-11-28, 2025-11-12, 2025-10-23), 0 of them exports. Second slug variant 'basco-tool-pvt-ltd' returned an empty/gated page (no rows visible).
domestic_evidence: No public GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved. thecompanycheck.com, eximpedia.app, trademo.com and volza.com all returned HTTP 403 Forbidden; DuckDuckGo search backend was down ('Connection refused'), so no domestic-supply query could be executed. Null, not estimated.
note: Declared HS 820220 (bandsaw blades) is NOT matched by any observed record: the only customs lines seen are imports of carbide saw tips under HS 82090010, step drills under HS 82079090, grinding machines under HS 84602990 and a screw compressor under HS 84148011 — i.e. the company appears in customs data as an IMPORTER of tooling components and machinery, not as an exporter of 820220. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; HS should be corrected to the actual traded code(s) and the company kept in the base. Per rule 5: no traces of export shipments found; domestic supply activity is unverified (unknown), not 'conditionally accepted'. Trading partners listed are Chinese suppliers (Zhuzhou Raryu Carbide, Chengdu Valuemax, Hanbell Precise Machinery, Lancetta Industrial) — consistent with an importer/distributor or tool-maker sourcing carbide blanks. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources). No CIN/PAN asserted — not verified.
